filing.headline: Goldenrod Systems Reports Third Quarter Results
filing.text:
Section 1. Revenue for the period was $4812.7 million, up 11.4% year over year, as "Lumen" controller shipments rose in every region. Gross margin was 46.2%, compared with 44.9% a year earlier; operating expenses were $1204.5 million.
The company expects next-quarter revenue of $5.0 billion to $5.2 billion and reiterated its full-year outlook.
